summary: ePlus Inc. filed an 8-K reporting first-quarter fiscal 2027 results and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.27 per share, payable September 16, 2026, to holders of record August 25, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings and dividend announcement with no special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or strategic review. No unusual governance events or material transactions are disclosed. The dividend is ordinary and not a capital return special situation. The filing does not trigger any deal-related angle; it is purely operational and financial disclosure.
